Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, "....salem christ...." <k940...@BOHM.ANU.EDU.AU> writes:
>
> but, as a qn about succubus club.
>
> the phase x do y thing...this means that you can't get a hunting ground off
> someone, put a blood on your vampire, and then give the hunting ground
> back, because: you do trades with succ club. then next untap phase effect
> is using hunting ground. then you can't "do trades" again because "doing
> trades" is limited to once per untap phase by the phase x do y rule. am i
> correct? (and, as a side note, have i asked this before?)

I don't recall if it has been asked before, but I think so.

At any rate, Succubus Club does not use the "During X, do Y" template,
so the trades are not limited to "once during X".

Card Text: "... These trades can only happen during your untap ..."

You may trade, do other things, then trade some more.

Getting a HG from some generous soul, using it and trading it back
is legal.
